lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A series of high-luminance circular pixel clusters are visible, arranged in roughly vertical columns and horizontal rows posterior to the gill region.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the circular high-luminance blobs, forming a grid-like lattice of anchor nodes across the lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent linear feature with a sharp vertical intensity gradient—exhibiting higher luminance on the dorsal side and shadowing on the ventral side—runs horizontally across the upper third of the flank.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A distinct, high-luminance 'L-shaped' marking or scar is visible on the upper lateral flank, superior to the pectoral fin.
